entities.summary: Benedikt Sigurðsson Gröndal was an Icelandic politician who served as prime minister of Iceland for 116 days in a minority government from 1979 to 1980. A member of the Social Democratic Party, he was minister of Foreign Affairs from 1978 to 1980 and the only Icelandic prime minister who served in two cabinet roles simultaneously.
